name: Conservation of mass and relative formula mass

terms.definition: No atoms are lost or made in a chemical reaction, so the mass of the products equals the mass of the reactants.
terms.examiner: Balanced equations have the same number of each atom on each side.

terms.definition: The sum of the relative atomic masses of the atoms in the formula.
terms.examiner: In a balanced equation, the sum of Mr of the reactants equals the sum of Mr of the products.

terms.definition: When a gas is given off and escapes, mass seems to go down; when a reactant is a gas from the air, mass seems to go up.
terms.examiner: Explain using the gas and the open container.

terms.definition: The range of a set of measurements about the mean; a measure of how far the true value may be from the mean.
